candidate.definition_en: Refined petroleum used as fuel for internal combustion engines, especially in motor vehicles.
candidate.explanation_ar: الوقود السائل المستخرج من البترول (البنزين) والمستخدم لتشغيل محركات السيارات والمركبات.

senses.definition_en: Refined petroleum used as fuel for internal combustion engines, especially in motor vehicles.
senses.explanation_ar: بنزين السيارات؛ وقود سائل يُستخدم لتشغيل المركبات.
examples: He stopped at the station to fill the tank with gasoline.
The car stopped because it ran out of gasoline.
The engine was designed to run on unleaded gasoline.

candidate.mnemonic: In American English, 'gasoline' is often shortened to 'gas'—the fuel that keeps your car on the line and moving forward.
